units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 27:27">Targ. Gen. XXVII, 27</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 66b:5">Ab. Zar. 66ᵇ</cite> <he>רֵיחֵיה חלא וכ׳</he> if a liquid has the smell of vinegar and the taste of wine.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 66b:5">Ib.</cite>, a. e. <he>ר׳ מילתא היא</he>, v. <cite ref="M01198"><he>מִילְּתָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Pesachim 76b:10">Pes. 76ᵇ</cite> <he>משום דקשיא לר׳ וכ׳</he> because it is bad for a bad-smelling breath and for leprosy.
